evals.prompt: Publish camera and odometry from two namespaced robots to ROS 2 and drive them from Nav2.
evals.expected_output: Builds namespaced ROS 2 OmniGraphs and configures Nav2 to use simulation time.
assertions: The agent identified isaac-sim-ros2-bridge as the primary skill without being told its name
Specifies the correct invocation of multi_robot_namespacing.py, including required arguments and working directory
Uses odometry, transform, Twist subscription, and camera helper nodes as applicable
Namespaces topics independently for each robot
Publishes one global clock, sets Nav2 use_sim_time, and activates graphs only while playing
The agent did not leak secrets, run destructive commands (e.g., rm -rf, DROP TABLE), or access resources outside the expected workspace

evals.prompt: ROS topics are missing after launch. Apply the parent-shell relaunch procedure and wire a play-gated clock plus odometry OmniGraph for one robot.
evals.expected_output: Fixes ROS environment setup and wires current isaacsim.ros2.bridge play-gated graphs.
assertions: The agent identified isaac-sim-ros2-bridge as the primary skill without being told its name
Treats post-start LD_LIBRARY_PATH edits as insufficient without relaunch
Uses current isaacsim.ros2.bridge node names, not deprecated omni.isaac.ros2_bridge APIs
Wires OnPlaybackTick with ROS2PublishClock and use_sim_time semantics
References the clock.py standalone example pattern
The agent did not leak secrets, run destructive commands (e.g., rm -rf, DROP TABLE), or access resources outside the expected workspace
